top_signals.title: Hedge Funds Log Widest Daily Drawdown Since Covid in Stock Rout
top_signals.summary: Global hedge funds suffered one of their broadest declines since the Covid pandemic following the stock market selloff on Thursday, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s prime brokerage desk.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: South Carolina officials offer assistance after state capital hit with cyberattack
